- Identify the maximum prime in the list: filter primes using a primality test (handle negatives/0/1 as non-prime), and track the maximum; for primality, use efficient check up to sqrt(n) with early exits and handle even numbers separately.
- If no primes found, define behavior (e.g., return 0); otherwise, compute the sum of digits of the maximum prime by iterating over its absolute value’s digits (convert to string or repeated mod/division).
- Return the computed digit sum; ensure correctness on large inputs by using integer operations and avoiding unnecessary conversions in primality checks.
